terms.gloss: hew, chip into shape with an axe or adze
evidence: Cato, Agr. 14: dolābit, secābit, of the contractor’s timber work

phrases.english: The carpenter is dressing the beam with the adze.
who was dressing a beam with the adze

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
